Q: RT's spin share >= 0.2, P 0.85 (the loop is there with the trace on). HS (the report waits in the queue for a finish): RT q2e >= 2 ms for >= 0.3 of its reports, P 0.25. HG (it waits on the GPU and fence after the handoff): q2w >= 2 ms share minus q2e >= 2 ms share >= 0.3, P 0.15. HB (it is written promptly once the PFIFO reaches it; the poll waits for the PFIFO's backlog or the guest's kick): q2w < 1 ms for >= 0.7, P 0.5. RM: RC's q2e >= 2 ms share <= 0.1 and >= 1 catch-up finish a frame, P 0.25. RS: RC's spin share <= 0.5 x RT's, P 0.2. RE: RC ms/f <= 0.9 x RT, P 0.2. RG: RC <= 33.4 ms/f over the span, P 0.05.
